"""tickwatch: one idle tick a call, and the numbers of that tick on a line (an instrument)."""
import json, sys
LOOP = True
s = json.load(sys.stdin)
p = s["pos"] or {}
with open("mine/ticks.jsonl", "a") as f:
    f.write(json.dumps({"step": s["step"], "hp": s["health"], "food": s["food"],
                        "x": round(p.get("x", 0), 2), "y": round(p.get("y", 0), 2),
                        "z": round(p.get("z", 0), 2), "pitch": round(p.get("pitch", 0), 1),
                        "yaw": round(p.get("yaw", 0), 1), "inv": s["inventory"],
                        "gui": s["gui_open"], "fire": s["fire_frac"]}) + "\n")
print(json.dumps({"actions": [{"action": {}, "repeat": 1}], "again": True}))
